description: This file defines the 'InvalidOperationOnObjectException' class, a custom exception in the org.openmrs.api package, used to signal illegal operations performed on objects within the OpenMRS API.

classes.name: InvalidOperationOnObjectException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating an invalid operation attempted on an object, extends APIException.

methods.name: InvalidOperationOnObjectException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with a specific error message.

methods.name: InvalidOperationOnObjectException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with a message and underlying cause.

methods.name: InvalidOperationOnObjectException(String messageKey, Object[] parameters)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with a message key and parameters, possibly for localization.

methods.name: InvalidOperationOnObjectException(Class clazz)
methods.description: Constructor that generates a default message based on the class of the object on which the invalid operation was attempted.
